What is an operating system?

Tech Compass · Updated 2026-10-19

IN THIS GUIDE

The quick answerWhat it does for youWhy apps need the right versionKeep it supportedFurther reading
THE QUICK ANSWER

An operating system manages a device’s hardware and gives applications a common set of services. Windows, macOS, Linux distributions, Android, and iOS are familiar examples.

What it does for you

The operating system manages memory, files, devices, and running programs. It provides the interface you use to open apps and change settings, plus permissions that control what programs can access.

Why apps need the right version

Apps are built for particular operating systems and hardware. An app for one system will not necessarily run on another. Check the developer’s system requirements and obtain installers from the official source.

Keep it supported

Security updates repair known weaknesses. Check the vendor’s support information for your version. Before a major upgrade, back up important data and check that your essential apps and devices remain compatible.

Settings and hardware vary by device. Follow documentation for your specific model and software version.
